notes: Universal companion AI 0.8.6. Fixes a combat stall where the panel retained a valid target/last action but the engine action queue became ACTION_INVALID after equipment/AI interaction: a conservative watchdog replans every two ticks only when combat is valid and no protected action lock is active. PRC's own familiar scaling remains separate. Preserves 0.8.5 buff strip/offhand, 0.8.4 spell fixes, and 0.8.3 autoheal.
